body.message:
Good evening Mr. Tim,

We have received an update that you would like to reserve the unit for a period of 6 months. We are pleased to offer you a rate of AED 9,000 per 30 days.

Kindly let us know your preferred payment method. If you would like to complete the full 6-month payment in advance, we can proceed accordingly. Alternatively, for monthly payments, the first and last month’s rent will need to be paid in advance in order to secure and block the unit for the full 6-month period.

Please also note that in the event of an early cancellation before the completion of the agreed rental period, the final month rental amount will be non-refundable.
We look forward to your confirmation and will be happy to assist you further.
